text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Camping in Hokkaido! Waheeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As promised, we take time off during summer camp to visit Hokkaido again, and the three of us decide to enjoy the great outdoors.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hi-yah! ☆ How's this, Palmster? Do you think I have a chance of landing a big one now?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, for sure. Now we just gotta stay still and…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! ♪ Look at us! Sweetfish've got nothing on how sweet it is to go fishing with your bestie! We're charged up on vibes! Waheyyy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, you'll spook the fish!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ugh, it got away… Man, that low key sucks…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: BBQ! ☆ BBQ! ★ With lots of yakisoba too! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sizzle…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh dang, this is bussin'! ♪ Palmster, what's in this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Chives, potatoes, and stuff. I winged the seasoning. Does it taste okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's good for sure, but like… I guess in a home-cooked kinda way. I'd be down to eat this three times a day, no cap! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's good to hear! Help yourself, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's nothing fancy about Mejiro Palmer's yakisoba. It's just comforting and warm, like a lovingly cooked meal at home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's not trying to be something it's not, and that's what makes it so tasty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Okay, time to taste the coffee my bestie made!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ugh! There are weird chunks in this! Helios, what are these?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, those are tapioca pearls! ♪ Get my boba coffee, in stores now! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Did you just toss some into the coffee for the heck of it?! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You know, the way we camp is all over the place, but it's fun as anything!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I wish I could do this forever!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ooh, sounds like you got an epiphany. ☆ Maybe you should drop the cleats and become a full-time outdoor Umatube vlogger!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Partygirl Camper ☆" has a nice ring to it, don'tcha think? You can try to go viral and become a top streamer online!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ooh, an Umatube vlogger? You know, that could be it for me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I could make Hokkaido my base and shoot fun vids here! There's tons of stuff I could do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What do you think'll get views, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I think of outdoorsy videos, the first thing that comes to mind is…
choice_data_list: Toughing it out in the cold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh wow, a farm? I could make a whole homestead for party lovers! That sounds tough, but that'll rack up views, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wa-wa-wa-waheeeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna till this place up from corner to corner! Aw yeah! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, bestie, how about we break for lunch? Let's have a salmon party with the catch we hauled in today!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yikes, my arms feel like they're gonna break from this. ★ Maybe we should we go all in on arm wrestling instead of racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My muscles are getting a workout just imagining that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ooh, like an endurance challenge or something? True, the temp dips real low out here in winter, and it snows too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Urgh… Bestie, this cold is no joke! Let's try to count the vibes to pass time…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, one vibe… Shiver… Two vibes… Shiver… Whoa, snow bunnies are partying it up in my head…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Th-this is rough for sure… But I can hold out, I know it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This level of cold is nothing like the chilly weather we get at Tracen Academy. This will build perseverance in no time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nature's weird when you think about it, though. I used to think there was nothing out here when I was a kid…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But I was way off. You can do anything you think of out here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Yeah, I'm the one who decides what I want to do.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days pass…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn… Is it mornin' already?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Everything is just so fun. Fishing, foraging, cooking, and making vids.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I'm totally free! I can do whatever I wanna do! I can live however I wanna live! But if that's the case…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Then what is it I really want to do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I'll just close my eyes… and ask myself…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (What do I want to do? What is my heart saying? Tell me what my true feelings are, and what I'm screaming for at my very core.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (What are the feelings that are surging up in me? If I were free to do whatever I wanted, what would I be doing?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's this?

text_block_list.name: Faint Voices
text_block_list.text: Wooooo…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: These voices…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooooosh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The wind. Just like the wind…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I… I'm—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wake up in my tent. Wiping my eyes, I step outside and see…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (The wind feels amazing! Fresh air in my lungs… Warm sunshine on my skin…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (This is all I want. Just this. I don't need opponents or a finish line. All I need is…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All I need is to run as fast as I want, as far as I want! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer races across an open field at daybreak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She looks so in her element, so alive… and absolutely stunning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Running is the answer. Running is what I love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It doesn't have to do with how far or how fast I can go, but when I let my mind go blank and just run…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: My neck tenses and shivers go down my back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I wasn't running for any particular reason just now. The sight of the horizon opening up before me made my heart and legs surge forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's why I know for sure that what I love to do… is simply to run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We share a smile. No further words are needed. It seems that, at long last, Mejiro Palmer has glimpsed her true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer? Do you see Mount Yotei right behind us?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I turn around and look at the mountain standing over Mejiro Palmer's hometown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Way back when, I used to be kinda scared of it. It felt like it was watching me and making sure I ran properly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It was like I had this huge pressure always looming over me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She was scared of it as a child, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm still scared by it!
choice_data_list: Your feelings about it haven't changed?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nah, they have. It's not as scary as before. And about time, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Today, I finally showed it what my real running is like. It wasn't jaw-dropping or anything, but it was my running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Today, I ran just 'cause I felt like it!
